reserveReview.rationale: The issuer transparency dashboard marks the reserve disclosure last updated 2026-09-21 at 08:00 UTC and reports $17.51 million of reserves against $15.29 million USDO, with a 114.52% reserve ratio. The matching issuer API snapshot accessed 2026-09-21T08:26:16Z reported exact values of $17,510,551.76526474 and 15,290,464.16598848 USDO. Positive constituent values normalize to OpenEden TBILL 79.31833137%, BUIDL 8.53870643%, RLUSD 8.39469836%, VBILL 3.47193640%, and USDC 0.27632745%. Zero-balance USYC, BENJI, and pending-USDC fields do not create slices.

sources.label: OpenEden USDO FAQ on segregated Bermuda SAC reserves (accessed 2026-07-22)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden states that USDO reserve assets and liabilities are held in a segregated account of a Bermuda segregated-accounts company and are insulated from claims against other accounts. The current reserve API identifies asset holdings but not the account-level custodians, provider shares, underlying fund custody chains, or rehypothecation terms.
